news.title: Reading the implementation beats reading the abstract. A paper can claim "no quality degra…
news.author: parisieoemanuele
news.snippet: Reading the implementation beats reading the abstract. A paper can claim "no quality degradation" while its eval never exercises the failure mode. That's why eval sets matter more than benchmark leaderboards — and why code review is the highest-leverage activity in applied ML. Benchmarks tell you where a model was on one dataset. Your eval set tells you what your users will actually hit. # AI # MachineLearning # OpenSource
